_doc: DETAIL BIBLE v3: every decision about a Short, made BEFORE the build (PIPELINE_V3.md stage A3). Keys that start with '_' are comments; the validator ignores them. Builders build ONLY what this file says; anything they need that is missing is a bible change (the LEAD edits it, re-validates, notes it in CHANGES). Names in 'kit' / 'surface' / 'rig' / 'preset' fields come from the kit catalogs (studio/src/kit/*/NOTES.md and studio/public/kit/*); an item the kit does not have yet is marked "new": true (a kit request) or "local": true (built inside videos3/<slug>/sets/). Validate: PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 tools/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -s tools/v3/bible_validate.py briefs/v3/<slug>/bible.json
title: <Video title>

status._doc: who signed what. gate1 = the owner approved script + voice + storyboard (PIPELINE_V3 stage A5). After gate1 only the LEAD changes this file, and every change is logged in CHANGES.

voice._doc: locked = the final assembled voice is installed and the owner OK'd the mp3. words_json is the timing source for every shot once locked; before that, shots use the linter's estimates (est_t0).

look._rigs: CORE rigs.ts: golden (default, the owner's pick), morning, noon, overcastWarm, dusk, interiorWarm, nightPractical
look.notes: warm, bright, golden (memory feedback_warm_bright_look); mean chroma ~24, near-neutral shadows; ink only on the cards

sets._doc: one set = one built place (built once, reused by every shot that names it). kit_base = a reusable kit room / street the set starts from (cheaper than a new set: say which).
sets.place: <what it reads as at phone size, in one line>
sets.kit_base: surfaces/interior | surfaces/facade | <a set from an earlier v3 film> | null

shots._doc: one row of the shot table. est_t0 = seconds from the linter (--json lines[].t) until the voice is locked; starts_on = the first spoken word of the shot (add #2 for its 2nd occurrence) - after the voice lock the scaffold maps it to a frame (a cut lands ~4-6 f before its word).
shots.beat: Hook | Stakes | Doubter | Escalation | Gauge | Clue | Loop | Answer | Why | Twist | Payoff
shots.location: <the spot inside the set, e.g. 'the fridge wall'>

framings._doc: a framing = what a still at that moment shows. A new framing about every 2.5 s (a cut, or a camera move that ends on a new composition). subject_height_pct = the focal character's height as % of the frame (35-60 except wides / inserts).
framings.subject: <cast id or prop id>

camera._doc: a CORE camera preset (camera.ts: lowWideTrack, pushIn, pullBack, droneRise, craneDown, orbit, followSide, povHandheld, macroTopDown, whipPan, lockedWithDrift) + its params; speed_pct_f = the planned median on-screen speed (% of frame per frame, look_metrics formula); bible_validate replaces it with CORE's camSpeedStats() when the film code exists.

light.notes: <shafts / dapple / window bars across the face>

life._doc: >= 3 things moving besides the camera (wind, people, birds, dust, cars, smoke...). audible: true needs a sound event.

captions._doc: auto = 1-3 words per chunk from words.ts in the house style (caption band y 1280-1440 at 1080x1920); overrides: [{word, text}]

music.end: stops on the last word; only the ambience runs through the loop tail

loop.last: <how the last frame flows into frame 0>
